name: Nisroch
overview: The Bible references Nisroch as an idol worshipped by Sennacherib, king of Assyria, in the house dedicated to this god. While Sennacherib dwelt in Nineveh, he was ultimately killed by his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer while worshipping Nisroch, leading to Esarhaddon succeeding him. These events highlight the futility of idolatry and the sovereign hand of God over human rulers and their false gods.
